limitations.description: 782 records point only to generic official source pages rather than item-specific detail pages.
limitations.impact: Users cannot deep-link to a dedicated official detail page for these records.
limitations.why_accepted: The official publishers expose a generic public page for the relevant records; the UI does not claim those pages are item-specific.
limitations.workaround: Use the preserved official source name and source context; avoid treating the landing page as a detail page.
limitations.future_action: Monitor publisher changes and replace links only when a stable official item URL is available.

limitations.description: 120 legacy closed reviews predate versioned audit metadata.
limitations.impact: Some historic actor/timestamp fields are unavailable.
limitations.why_accepted: The system preserves unknown values and does not invent an actor or resolution time; no current/open review is affected.
limitations.workaround: Refer to the retained review state and mark unavailable audit metadata as unknown.
limitations.future_action: Keep complete versioned provenance on all new decisions; do not reopen old reviews to manufacture history.

limitations.description: Source-aware freshness gate warns for MODON, NHC, and MWAN; current freshness is stale for MODON/NHC and aging for MWAN.
limitations.impact: Public source evidence may lag the latest scheduled verification; this is not a database or API failure.
limitations.why_accepted: The three sources remain scheduled and are separately classified; local services are healthy and the freshness gate is warning severity.
limitations.workaround: Monitor source health/last success and allow normal scheduled verification; no manual sync was started.
limitations.future_action: Review the next scheduled complete-scan/scope-verification outcomes and escalate repeated technical failures.

limitations.description: Historical runtime anomaly gate identifies jobs 496, 500, 393, and 497.
limitations.impact: These past job durations need operational context but no job is currently active or nonterminal.
limitations.why_accepted: Anomaly records are historical; current queue is empty and the source inventory/reconciliation remains stable.
limitations.workaround: Inspect job IDs/log correlation when diagnosing a future recurrence.
limitations.future_action: Continue runtime monitoring and tune timeouts only from measured source behavior.
